verdict.rationale: Phaser Studio's first-party ecosystem includes a hosted Phaser Game Agent that takes plain-language requests ('What game do you want me to make?', 'Give the player a double-jump… make gravity stronger'). The Phaser Editor page also describes an assistant that handles tasks like creating particle emitters, reorganising layers and renaming objects 'without switching tools'. The assistant lives in the Editor/Agent products rather than the core npm library, and the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the in-editor assistant's scope and limits, clarity on whether it ships with the core framework or only with Editor/Agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of delegated tasks working.
